items.item_text: 01. This application will ONLY be used to fill TEMPORARY positions with SCCCD. Are you available for a temporary position at this time? Options: Yes | No

02. (MQ) Please select the level of education you possess in business administration, public administration or a related field: Please attach copies of your degrees or transcripts showing the date the degrees were awarded. Applications without this documentation may be deemed incomplete. Options: Formal or informal education equivalent to completion of the twelfth grade OR no related degree | Associate's degree | Bachelor's degree | Master's degree or higher

03. (MQ) Please describe your related experience in Admissions and Records office. Please include the following: - Name of the employer(s) - Position title(s) you held - Type of duties: This information will also need to be identifiable in the work history portion of the application, or the application may be deemed incomplete.

04. (MQ) Please select the years of increasingly responsible experience in a college Admissions and Records office you possess: Options: Less than six (6) years' experience | Six (6) to less than seven (7) years' experience | Seven (7) to less than nine (9) years' experience | Nine (9) to less than eleven (11) years' experience | Eleven (11) or more years' experience
05. (MQ) Do you possess at least two of which were managing or leading one or more specialty areas of admissions and records? Options: Yes | No

06. (MQ) Please describe your experience which you were managing or leading one or more specialty areas of admissions and records. Please include the following: - Name of the employer(s) - Position title(s) you held - Type of duties: This information will also need to be identifiable in the work history portion of the application, or the application may be deemed incomplete.

07. (MR) Certain assignments may require a California driver's license and the ability to maintain insurability under the Districts vehicle insurance program. Do you possess a valid driver's license? Options: Yes | No
